name: reserva-monorepo
description: RESERVA - Application de reservation planifiee pour la RDCongo

scripts.dev:mobile: cd apps/mobile_flutter && flutter run --flavor client -t lib/main.dart
scripts.dev:mobile:client: cd apps/mobile_flutter && flutter run --flavor client -t lib/main.dart
scripts.dev:mobile:pro: cd apps/mobile_flutter && flutter run --flavor pro -t lib/main_pro.dart
scripts.dev:platform: concurrently -n core,hotels,booking,transport,gw,web -c blue,magenta,green,white,yellow,cyan "npm run dev:core" "npm run dev:hotels" "npm run dev:booking" "npm run dev:transport" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/service-kit
scripts.ci:quality: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:generate:hotels && npm run db:generate:booking && npm run db:generate:transport && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:api && npm run build --workspace=@reserva/hotels && npm run build --workspace=@reserva/booking && npm run build --workspace=@reserva/transport && npm run build --workspace=@reserva/gateway && npm run build:web
scripts.ci:regression: npm run test:unit && npm run smoke:local && node scripts/check-openapi-contrat.mjs && node scripts/perf-smoke.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:all: npm run db:migrate:core && npm run db:migrate:hotels && npm run db:migrate:booking && npm run db:migrate:transport
scripts.analyze:mobile:ci: cd apps/mobile_flutter && flutter pub get && dart analyze lib/ && flutter test
scripts.setup:local: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run db:push:hotels && npm run db:seed:hotels && npm run db:push:booking && npm run db:push:transport && npm run db:seed:transport
